verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is itself a public HTTP API. It documents the r.jina.ai URL-reading endpoint, the s.jina.ai search endpoint, POST file uploads, and many control headers (x-respond-with, x-engine, x-max-tokens, x-json-schema, x-preset), with curl examples and a code builder for exploring parameters. Community output showing the live API's auth error confirms it is publicly reachable with an API key. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404) and llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: It converts any URL to an **LLM-friendly** input with `https://r.jina.ai/https://your.url`.
It searches the web for a given query with `https://s.jina.ai/your+query`.
PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can now be POSTed directly via the `file` body field
We highly recommend using the code builder to explore different parameter combinations of the Reader API.
Use the `x-json-schema` header with a JSON schema definition, or use `x-instruction` header with natural language instructions.
